translate_en|mods/AutoExercisePlus/42/me: AUTO
Repeat this exercise automatically, resting when needed. Tick this, then press Start below to begin.
Stop drinking above this intoxication (%%)
A safety cap. Alcohol is left alone once intoxication passes this.
Size of one sip (ml)
How much to drink at a time. Less means less intoxication. Raise it a little if the sip seems to do nothing.

Pick an exercise on the Fitness panel, tick AUTO and press Start. Your character will exercise, sit down to rest when tired, then get up and go again. Every setting below takes effect immediately, even mid-game.
Heavy Load level that halts exercise (0 = ignore)
Carrying too much is not something resting fixes, so auto mode stops once the Heavy Load moodle reaches this level.
Hold fast-forward while auto exercising

The game normally drops back to 1x whenever an action finishes, and auto exercise finishes an action every set, sip and sit-down. This holds the speed instead. It is released the moment things get dangerous - a zombie in sight, taking damage, catching fire - and again whenever auto mode stops. (No effect while connected to a multiplayer server - the server controls game time.)
Read this while resting
Bookmark every skill book carried
Bookmark every recipe magazine carried
Reading list for rest breaks

Read this book during the rest breaks of auto exercise. The bookmark applies to the book type rather than the single copy, so it survives picking up another copy. The book has to be in your main inventory to actually be read.
Give up after this many doses (0 = unlimited)
If this many doses in a row fail to bring the pain down, stop auto mode instead of working through everything you are carrying.
Easy Exercise
Exhausted level that still allows exercise

The base game refuses to exercise above this Exhausted moodle level. Set it to 4 and the moodle never gets in the way, leaving the endurance percentages above fully in charge. This also applies to the vanilla fitness panel.
Exhausted, I can't start another set. Catching my breath...

How to show messages
Where to show what auto exercise is doing and why it stopped.

Pain level that halts exercise (0 = never)

At this Pain level your character stops exercising and waits for the pain to ease. Keep it higher than the painkiller level above - if it is equal or lower, exercise halts the instant your character is sore enough to want a pill. For reference, the base game locks its own Start button at level 4.
Pain level that triggers a painkiller (0 = never)
Once the Pain moodle reaches this level, your character reaches for pills or alcohol. Set it to 0 to disable everything pain-related.
Hurts too much to exercise. Waiting for it to ease off...
Read recipe magazines
Bookmarked magazines that still teach a recipe you do not know. They are short and one-off, so they are read before skill books.
Read skill books
Only bookmarked skill books you can read right now and still have a multiplier to gain from. Books above your level and books you have already used up are skipped.
Read bookmarked books while resting

Read while sitting and waiting for endurance to come back. Sitting recovers endurance at exactly the same rate whether you read or not, and sitting even makes reading slightly faster, so this costs you nothing. Pick what to read by right-clicking a book in your inventory, and keep it in your main inventory (books inside bags are not read).
Some reading while I rest:
Minimum gap between painkillers (minutes)
Keeps your character from swallowing one dose after another. Nothing is taken while a dose is still working, so this only matters when pain outlasts the effect.
Sit down at this endurance (%%)
Once endurance falls below this, the current set is cut short and your character sits on the ground.
Worn out... let me sit until I get my wind back
Stand back up at this endurance (%%)
Once endurance recovers to this while resting, your character gets up and starts the next set. Keep it higher than the value above.

Length of one set (in-game minutes)
How long a single set runs. It ends sooner if endurance runs out first.
Health at which the speed is released (%%, 0 = ignore)
Stops holding fast-forward once overall health falls below this. Meant to catch slow drains such as starvation or illness.
Repeat the same reason every (minutes, 0 = once)
How often to say the reason again while your character still cannot exercise.

Health at which exercise halts (%%, 0 = ignore)
Switches auto mode off once overall health falls below this, whatever the cause - hunger, illness or injury.

Stop when there is nothing to treat the pain with
If pain is blocking exercise and there are no pills or alcohol left, switch auto mode off rather than sitting there indefinitely.
Stop when the Fitness panel is closed
Turn this off and auto exercise keeps running after you close the panel.
Stop when taking damage
Switches auto mode off when health drops sharply. This catches being hit by something; slow drains like hunger are handled by the health threshold above.
Stop when you take control
Switches auto mode off the moment you press a movement key, aim or attack. Only character input counts, so clicking buttons on the Fitness panel will not stop it.

Sip alcohol (tongue-dipping)
Drinks a tiny amount of any alcoholic drink. The game grants the same painkiller effect no matter how much you drink, so a single sip works while barely making you drunk.
